title: chenopodium glaucum f. minus
intro: Chenopodium glaucum f. minus, commonly known as leafy goosefoot or lamb's quarters, is a variety of the Chenopodium glaucum plant. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, inflammation, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Chenopodium glaucum f. minus include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which help to reduce swelling, prevent infection, and tighten tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
